messages:
carol-infra: alerting — we just detected complete control-plane reachability loss for eu-west-2. health checks failing across clusters (api, scheduler, controller).

alice-oncall: seeing same from monitoring. grafana panels show prometheus scrape gap ~30s ago. any idea if this is network or provider-wide?

ben-sre: pods still running on nodes but kube-apiserver is flapping. CSI calls timing out. suspect a provider network ACL change or upstream LB.

dima-network: VPC control plane route table shows 0.0.0.0/0 blackhole for a subset of subnets — investigating with provider. filing a support case now.

carol-infra: ok, immediate steps: 1) freeze non-essential deploys 2) start traffic shift plan to fallback region 3) open incident bridge if not already.

deploy-bot: Deploy freeze applied to eu-west-2: tags=production, type=rolling.

alice-oncall: opening bridge — https://meet.example.com/redwood-incident-1833008888. invited oncall + network + prodops.

eva-prodops: for traffic shift: we have capacity in us-east-1 but GPU pools are at 70% — can burst reserved pool? also some models pinned to quantized instances only in eu-west-2.

ben-sre: we can route inference traffic to us-east-1 using smart-routing policy + degrade model profile if necessary. will create temporary routing rule: eu-west-2 -> us-east-1 with fallback weight 100%.

carol-infra: ben, do we have enough KV cache for the increased seq lengths there? any latency SLO implications?

ben-sre: cache hit ratio will drop initially. expect +30-50ms tail latency for chat flows, and cold-cache token cost bump. logging will flag quality regressions; recommend enabling lower batch sizes to keep p95 under target.

dima-network: provider support responds: "Investigating backbone disruption affecting control-plane IPs for eu-west-2; restorative action underway." ETA unknown.

alice-oncall: begin shift now. ben — paste the command you want ops to run.

ben-sre: run the routing switch playbook:```sh
redwoodctl route update --from-region eu-west-2 --to-region us-east-1 --weight 100 --models '{"all":"fallback"}' --dry-run=false
```

eva-prodops: executing. watch logs for traffic spikes on us-east-1. also kicking up ephemeral GPU autoscale: scale up +4 gpus (p3-equivalent).

k8s-bot: HorizontalPodAutoscaler eu-inference scaled from 18 -> 26 replicas.

carol-infra: cost note: ephemeral autoscale and cold-runs will add ~ $12k/day if sustained. log cost center: infra-emergency.

ben-sre: monitoring: set temporary alert mute for eu-west-2 noisy alerts, and create separate alert for cross-region failover latency.

alice-oncall: provider updated: "Control plane routes restored for subset; node API still degraded. Continuing recovery ops."

dima-network: partial control-plane reachability restored — some apis respond, but etcd leader election bounced; we should not shift back until stable for 30m.

carol-infra: summary and action items: 1) traffic shifted to us-east-1 (completed) 2) reserved burst scaled +4 GPUs 3) provider engaged and partial recovery in progress 4) cost tracked to infra-emergency 5) dont rollback routing until 30m stable and postmortem to follow.

eva-prodops: acknowledging. I will coordinate customer comms for impacted Dedicated tenants.

alice-oncall: updating incident channel and paging list. will update every 15m or on significant change.

carol-infra: thanks team. tagging for follow-ups: @ben-sre for routing rollback plan, @dima-network for root-cause, @eva-prodops for billing/comms.

deploy-bot: Incident incident-1833008888 created (severity=P2).
